tagline: The party's over. That's not stopping us
rules:
D After Party — Instance Rules

1. 18+ Only

This is a strictly 18+ community. Underage users are not allowed under any circumstances.

If you are found to be under 18, you will be immediately removed from the instance and the group.

2. Be Respectful

Treat everyone with basic respect — staff, regulars, and newcomers alike. Personal issues or relationships do not give anyone a free pass to be rude or hostile.

Persistent disrespect will result in a warning, kick, or ban depending on severity.

3. No Drama / Toxicity

Leave past and present drama outside the instance. Do not instigate, bait, or deliberately provoke others.

Inflammatory behavior or intentionally trying to start arguments will result in moderation action.

4. No Prejudice or Discrimination

Racism, sexism, homophobia, transphobia, ableism, or any other form of bigotry is not tolerated.

Being old enough to drink does not give you a free pass to be an asshole. Keep that energy out of the instance.

5. Consent & Boundaries

Ask before doing anything that involves another person’s avatar or personal space, especially anything intimate or sexual.

No means no. Pressuring people, repeatedly bothering someone, or ignoring their boundaries will get you removed.

6. Responsible Drinking Vibe

This is a drinking group — have fun, but don’t pressure anyone to drink, whether real or virtual.

Excessive harassment, spam, or disruptive behavior while “drunk” is still against the rules.

7. Games, Cards & Wheels

You do not need a moderator to deal cards, spin a wheel, or host a game.

If you want to start something, go for it! Grab some people, deal the cards, spin the wheel, and have fun.

If you would like a moderator to host something, you’re welcome to ask politely. We may be able to help, but it is not guaranteed.

Remember: this is an after-party. We might be just as hammered, distracted, or caught up in the fun as you are. 😂

8. No Ear Rape / Disruptive Audio

We’re here to have a good time, but please be respectful of the people around you.

If you’re playing music, using a soundboard, or sharing audio, please keep it reasonable and be mindful of your surroundings. The lobby is a shared space, so don’t blast music or sounds over everyone else’s conversations.

If people around you are having a conversation, listening to their own music, or enjoying the world’s music, please don’t drown them out. Not everyone wants to hear what you’re playing.

If you want to play music loudly or have your own music session, take it to a private/VIP room where you can enjoy it without disturbing others.

Live DJ playing? Let the DJ cook. 🎧Please do not play your own music, soundboard, or competing audio while a live DJ is performing. If you want to listen to something else, please move to a private/VIP room instead.

Keep your mic volume reasonable, avoid loud/high-pitched or spammy sounds, and use push-to-talk when appropriate.

Basically: vibe with the room, not against it.

9. No Advertising / Self-Promo

Don’t spam links or recruit for other groups or instances unless staff has given you permission.

10. Drinking Songs & Party Music 🍻

Drinking songs, party songs, and group sing-alongs are absolutely welcome — that’s part of the D After Party vibe!

Feel free to play them in the lobby, VIP/private rooms, or somewhere away from large groups, as long as you’re not disturbing the people around you.

If a large group is having a conversation, listening to their own music, enjoying world music, or simply chilling, please give them some space and keep your drinking songs at a reasonable volume. If someone asks you to lower it or move, please be respectful and do so.

If someone is already using a player in a VIP/private room, please ask before joining in with your own music. If they’re already listening to something, just find another spot where you can enjoy your music without disturbing them.

Want to turn it up and get the whole crew singing? Take it to a VIP/private room or find a spot away from the main crowd. As long as you’re not disrupting someone else’s experience, have fun and enjoy yourself.

Basically: If your drinking song turns into everyone else’s drinking song without their consent... you might be the DJ nobody asked for. 😂🍻

“Shots? AbsoluteCoyote? Take your asses to the corner where you always play drinking songs. 😂🍻”

10. Staff Decisions Are Final

If a moderator asks you to stop something or leave, please do so.

Arguing with staff, refusing to follow instructions, or escalating the situation may result in additional punishment.
infoBoard:
🌙 D AFTER PARTY 🍻

**The night doesn't have to end when the party does.**

Still wide awake? Not ready to call it a night? Looking for people who match your energy?

**Welcome to D After Party.**

Whether you're rolling in solo, bringing a group of friends, or pulling up with your whole crew — **you're welcome here.**

We’re here for the people who want to keep the night going, meet new people, find the right vibe, and make some memories along the way.

Come hang out.
Meet someone new.
Bring your friends.
Bring your crew.
Join a conversation.
Play some games.
Deal some cards.
Spin a wheel.
Dance.
Listen to music.
Find a DJ.
Start your own little party.

You don't need to know anyone when you walk in. **Just bring your energy and see where the night takes you.**

🍻 SAME NIGHT. DIFFERENT VIBE.

Maybe you're coming from a party and you're not ready to call it a night.

Maybe everyone else went home and you're still going.

Maybe you're just looking for a group of people who are **on the same wavelength as you.**

Whatever brought you here, **pull up a seat and stay awhile.**

🎉 FIND YOUR PEOPLE

D After Party is about finding people who want the same thing:

**Good energy. Good people. Good times.**

Come solo. Come with friends. Come with your whole crew.

You can chill, socialize, party, dance, play games, or end up in a random conversation with someone you just met.

Sometimes the best nights are the ones you never planned.

WHEN EVERYONE ELSE GOES HOME...

**We keep going.**

Welcome to the **D After Party.**

*Come for the after-party. Stay for the people. Leave with a memory.*
